facts.statement: A community webcast about the Festival of Hearts aired on February 9, 2012, hosted by Referee Ruby with artist Nafisah Tung and designer Chris Fritchoff.
facts.quote: If you missed the webcast on February 9, 2012, watch it below

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community webcast recap on the Festival of Hearts event. Referee Ruby hosted, with artist Nafisah Tung and designer Chris Fritchoff showing off animations for several new Festival of Hearts items. The page gives no exact post date; it was posted about 5 days before the 2012-02-19 capture, and the webcast itself aired February 9, 2012.
